title: Antarctic Sea Ice Lost 1.3 Million Square Kilometers
hook: Antarctic sea ice lost 1.3 million square kilometers.
closing: Less reflective ice leaves more heat in the ocean, amplifying warming beyond Antarctica.
question: Did you expect a loss this large?

segments.say: Antarctic sea ice shrank to 1.79 million square kilometers, setting a record low in the supplied comparison.
The missing ice spans 1.3 million square kilometers, erasing an area larger than two major states combined.
Sea ice reflects 60% of sunlight, so losing it lets the darker ocean absorb far more heat.
